{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# 70B ZS SciERC: unconstrained + full_s1 constrained on cuda:1
set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie

MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4"
DATA="data/processed_data/test.json"
CONSTRAINTS="ontology_constraints.json"
DATASET="scierc"
MAX_NEW_TOKENS=2048

echo "=========================================="
echo "70B ZS SciERC experiment"
echo "Model: $MODEL"
echo "GPU: cuda:1 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1)"
echo "Start: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

# --- 1) Unconstrained ---
OUT_UC="outputs/r16_70b_scierc_zs_unconstrained.jsonl"
echo ""
echo ">>> [1/2] Unconstrained inference starting at $(date)"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode unconstrained \
    --dataset "$DATASET" \
    --model_path "$MODEL" \
    --data_path "$DATA" \
    --constraints_path "$CONSTRAINTS" \
    --output_path "$OUT_UC" \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --batch_size 1 \
    --seed 42 \
    --max_new_tokens "$MAX_NEW_TOKENS" \
    --decoding_strategy greedy \
    --temperature 0.0 \
    --skip_on_error
echo ">>> [1/2] Unconstrained done at $(date)"

# Violation check
echo ">>> Violation check: unconstrained"
python3 violation_checker.py \
    --input_path "$OUT_UC" \
    --constraints_path "$CONSTRAINTS" \
    --output_path "outputs/r16_70b_scierc_zs_unconstrained_violations.json"

# --- 2) Constrained (full_s1) ---
OUT_CS="outputs/r16_70b_scierc_zs_full_s1.jsonl"
echo ""
echo ">>> [2/2] Constrained (full_s1) inference starting at $(date)"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode full_s1 \
    --dataset "$DATASET" \
    --model_path "$MODEL" \
    --data_path "$DATA" \
    --constraints_path "$CONSTRAINTS" \
    --output_path "$OUT_CS" \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --batch_size 1 \
    --seed 42 \
    --max_new_tokens "$MAX_NEW_TOKENS" \
    --decoding_strategy greedy \
    --temperature 0.0 \
    --skip_on_error
echo ">>> [2/2] Constrained done at $(date)"

# Violation check
echo ">>> Violation check: full_s1"
python3 violation_checker.py \
    --input_path "$OUT_CS" \
    --constraints_path "$CONSTRAINTS" \
    --output_path "outputs/r16_70b_scierc_zs_full_s1_violations.json"

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "70B ZS SciERC complete"
echo "Outputs:"
echo "  $OUT_UC"
echo "  $OUT_CS"
echo "End: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="
